item.title: Blackbug
item.description: Blackbug is a critter in Core Keeper. Unlike hostile mobs, critters are peaceful creatures you can catch with a Bug Net and keep or feed. Where to find it It frequently spawns when destroying wooden objects — breaking Wood, Coral Wood or Gleam Wood has a 15% chance to spawn one, while breaking wooden crates (such as Wooden Crates and Large Crates) has a 30% chance to spawn 1–2 (or 5–8 from large crates).

item.title: Caveling
item.description: The Caveling is the basic hostile mob of The Undergrounds, found near the starting area. Low health and telegraphed attacks make it an easy first combat target. Tips Attacks are telegraphed — dodge sideways, not backwards Drops Caveling Remains used in early crafting

item.title: Caveling Assassin
item.description: The Caveling Assassin is a fast Desert caveling that fires a spread of three daggers and then dashes straight through its target. Its high speed and pass-through movement make it hard to pin down. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Caveling Brute
item.description: The Caveling Brute is a slow but hard-hitting melee enemy found in The Undergrounds and The Clay Caves. It hits much harder than a normal Caveling — don’t tank its swings. Combat tips Dodge, don’t block: its swings are telegraphed; sidestep rather than trading hits Kite it: it’s slower than the player, so attack between its swing cooldowns Iron gear comfort: with 140 HP and 16 damage, it’s manageable in copper but much safer in tin+ Drops Caveling Remains (common) — salvage/repair material Iron Ore (common) — early source before you reach The Forgotten Ruins

item.title: Caveling Gardener
item.description: The Caveling Gardener patrols Azeos’ Wilderness on Lush Moss, circling players before striking. While standing on grass it can sprout up to five Snare Plants that trap you in place. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Caveling Scholar
item.description: The Caveling Scholar appears in Forlorn Metropolis dungeons, firing a Scholar’s Staff at range and beaming heals onto nearby Scholars and Core Sentries. Take them out first or the whole room will sustain itself. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Caveling Skirmisher
item.description: The Caveling Skirmisher is a ranged mob of The Clay Caves that hurls spears on sight from Clay Moss tiles. Weaker than melee cavelings but annoying at range, it drops Larva Meat and Fiber when farmed. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Citrus Pinion
item.description: Citrus Pinion is a flying critter in Core Keeper. Unlike hostile mobs, critters are peaceful creatures you can catch with a Bug Net and keep or feed. It flutters erratically with bright colors that are irritating to the naked eye. Where to find it It spawns naturally in Azeos’ Wilderness. How to catch Equip a Bug Net and swing at it as you walk close Critters can be placed back in the world as persistent decoration Sell value: 1 Feeding Can be fed to Strolly Poly or Dodo.

item.title: Core Sentry
item.description: The Core Sentry is a large Forlorn Metropolis construct that stays dormant until you approach, then powers up and stomps a three-way fork of bright projectiles. Very high health makes it a priority target. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Orex
item.description: Orex is a cattle (farm animal) in Core Keeper. Unlike small critters, it is not caught with a Bug Net — it is raised as livestock and fed. Where to find it Found in the Moss Sub Biome in The Forgotten Ruins. This cavernous carnivore has a surprisingly timid temper for having such sharp horns; its large serrated muzzle is sooner to swallow critters whole than to bite the hand that may feed it.

item.title: Purple Slime
item.description: The Purple Slime is the poison slime of Azeos’ Wilderness, spawning on Ground Poison Slime. Its jumps apply poison that cuts healing received by 75%, so keep antidotes or a Remedaisy Necklace ready. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Red Slime
item.description: The Red Slime is the always-aggressive early slime of The Undergrounds and The Clay Caves. Unlike the passive Orange Slime it shares Ground Slime with, it will hop onto you on sight and is immune to slow and acid. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area
